integrity: The Gaussian factor/error decomposition and spectrum-blind expected squared Frobenius inflation are prior published results. The additional spectrum-indexed convex-risk and sharp moment analysis is explicitly distinguished from these premises.
scientific_scope: Real two-sided independent-Gaussian sketch; fixed orthonormal Q, nonzero orthogonal residual, exact arithmetic; squared-Frobenius normalized error. Convex order for ell>=r+2; finite variance for ell>=r+4; no unconditional random-Q ordering or every-tail stochastic dominance.
title: Residual-spectrum convex ordering and the exact Gaussian sketch failure law
